Fixtures for the media tests (all made with ffmpeg / Pillow, nothing copyrighted):

- `gps.jpg`: a JPEG whose EXIF carries a camera name ("SecretCam") and GPS coordinates.
- `location.mp4`: 2 s of red with a QuickTime location key and a title in its metadata.
- `tagged.webm`: 2 s of blue with a title tag.
- `long.mp4`: 30 s, longer than the default 15 s limit.
- `shell.jpg`: PHP code named like a photo.
- `polyglot.jpg`: JPEG magic bytes followed by HTML.
